data.rationale: The proposal gets the search flow right: Attractions & Tickets, then destination, keyword, search, sort and opening a result. But it leaves out the final step (view Nearby or add to favorites) and the action parameter, and it treats the opened result as a free choice instead of the top result. Its steps are still concrete and parameterized enough to build an automation from.
